description: Six padded prompt turns build up enough conversation history to exceed the Subject's tail-preservation budget, then a manual reset compaction runs. Passing requires canonical audit evidence of an actual context.compaction.started (trigger=manual, strategy=reset) and its completed source-tail-reset checkpoint -- configuration presence (a compact action in the Scenario) alone is not sufficient proof.
